clue.text: After drug overdose, caretaker means to perform convincingly

explanation.surface: A caretaker, having overdosed on a drug, is somehow still meant to put on a convincing show.
explanation.definitionFit: This school of performance has actors live inside a role's emotions so their portrayal feels real, a technique for convincing work.

clue.text: Improperly catch a little hoodlum — is he armed?

indicators.note: only a little of the following words is used, a run of letters lying inside them

parts.note: the letters run across hoodlum, is, he and armed

explanation.surface: Someone glimpses a small-time thug and wonders whether he is carrying a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch words badly is to fail to hear them correctly, which is exactly to mishear them.

clue.text: Don't stick first bit of stuffing in goose

explanation.walkthrough: In the card game pontoon (blackjack), you either stick with your hand or ask for another card, which is to twist.
explanation.definitionFit: In pontoon, refusing to stand on your hand means requesting another card, and that call is the opposite of sticking.

clue.text: Nothing by Liberal Party makes sense

clue.text: Surface of acrylic? I would trip on this

definitions.note: a cryptic description: the drug is what a person trips on

explanation.surface: Someone eyes a slippery acrylic floor and expects to trip on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trip' looks like stumbling on a slippery surface, but it is the drug sense: an hallucinogenic experience.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid is slang for LSD, the hallucinogen that sends users on a psychedelic trip.

clue.text: Carry On film, one using Amerindian symbols?

clue.text: Sky features new statement about sexuality

explanation.definitionFit: Nimbi is a plural of nimbus, a rain cloud or halo, both of which can appear overhead.

clue.text: Rising like little piece of bread

explanation.definitionFit: A rising, as a noun, is an upward movement or climb, which is what this word names.

clue.text: Tight sort of fleece given to female dressing

the abbreviation for female

clue.text: Does grouse: bird with sides of noodles

explanation.walkthrough: The alien goes round just the N at the front of the city, and the rest of the city's name trails after it.

the abbreviation for river

taken as written

clue.text: Walking-stick remains by factory

parts.note: ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: A walking-stick lies in the ruins beside a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a stout stick cut from a young tree of the ash family, used for walking.

clue.text: One may go off meat, say, eating wodges regularly

clue.text: Roughly painted two lots of furniture gold on the inside

clue.text: Small bookmaker, a dashing type

parts.note: the abbreviation for small
a printer makes books

clue.text: Guide vehicle around after 24 hours

clue.text: Did rock and roll material in recital

parts.note: suede is a soft leather material

explanation.definitionFit: Rocking and rolling are both side-to-side swinging movements, which is moving to and fro.

clue.text: So-and-so poking face using fingers

clue.text: Zero in test starting with pronoun in French lesson

zero looks like the letter O

clue.text: Dance with spirit, rating pirouettes

clue.text: Provocation about skirts for men?

clue.text: Copy carpeting of leaves

taken as written

clue.text: Place to drink single port

the Roman numeral for one

clue.text: First team gaining award, it's widely accepted
